messages:
Lina K: Draft release notes ready for review — trying to keep the public blurb short. PTAL: https://docs.internal/rn/1765987654
Lina K: Key asks: confirm model/version pin, callout for deduped batching change, and final rollback criteria.
Matt S: Looking now. Quick Q — are we pinning to v2.3.1 or the hotfix build v2.3.1-hf2?
Lina K: Pin to v2.3.1-hf2. Reason: last-minute performance fix for KV cache. I added a short note in the notes.
Raj P: Ops note: change window is 11:00–12:30 PDT tomorrow. We need canary for 10% for 15m then ramp if no errors.
DeployBot: scheduled deploy: release-1765987654 -> canary 10% @ 2026-04-14T18:00:00Z, full ramp @ 2026-04-14T18:20:00Z. CI checks passed.
Julia W: For rollback gates, recommend: 1) 5xx spike >1.5x baseline for 5m, 2) latency p95 increase >30% for 10m, 3) regression in our canned evals >2% quality drop.
Ops QA: Can confirm we have eval harness ready. Will run quick smoke set during canary and post results in thread.
Matt S: Typo in the bullet about batching — should be "prefix caching" not "prefetch caching". Small nit.
Lina K: Nice catch, fixed.
Raj P: Also: pin advisory to customers — include note that DB migration is NOT required and traffic routing is transparent.
Lina K: Adding that now. Also adding rollback playbook link: `//runbooks/release-rollback-1765987654` (internal).
DeployBot: deploybot note: if canary fails, automatic rollback will trigger after 3 failed healthchecks. Manual rollback command: `/deploy rollback release-1765987654`.
Ops QA: I'll post smoke results at +10m into canary. If any failure, I'll tag @oncall and mark for immediate rollback.
Matt S: One last ask — can we include a short plain-English line in RN about the perf win? "~12% p50 improvement for multi-turn chat".
Lina K: Done. Final pass ready. Planning to pin the internal announce at 09:30 PDT tomorrow.
Julia W: :thumbsup: I'll stand by during the window.
Lina K: Thanks team — merging and scheduling announce. If anything changes ping this thread.
